---
title: "3D Plot for Mike"
format: html
---

## Read in the Data

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
MikeData <- read_excel("../Data/MikeData.xlsx")
glimpse(MikeData)
```

```{r, fig.width = 8.5, fig.width = 8.5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(plotly)
p <- plot_ly(data = MikeData, 
             z = ~`GL Score`, 
             x = ~`TS Score`, 
             y = ~Year, 
             opacity = 0.25) %>% 
  add_markers
p
```
